lwIP 2.2.1 src/apps/mdns/{mdns.c,mdns_out.c,mdns_domain.c}
as shipped in pico-sdk 2.3.0 (lib/lwip at 77dcd25a72509eb83f72b033d219b1d40cd8eb95,
2025-02-05). BSD-3-Clause, the same licence and notice as the rest of lwIP
(licenses/lwIP.LICENSE). The headers are NOT copied: lwip/apps/mdns*.h still
come from the SDK, unchanged, which is what keeps this a drop-in for the
SDK's pico_lwip_mdns library (CMakeLists.txt uses these files instead).

Why vendored: the firmware answers mDNS for record groups that scripts
declare (mdns.group{} in Lua: A, PTR, SRV and TXT records for names that are
not the device's own -- src/net/mdns.c, src/net/mdns_records.c), and lwIP's
responder has no API for that. Those records must be answered from source
port 5353, and only one pcb can own the port, so the queries have to be seen
from inside lwIP's receive path.

Local changes: ONE, in mdns.c (search for "LOCAL CHANGE"):

  mdns_recv() calls btgw_mdns_query_hook(netif, p, addr, port, recv_unicast)
  for every query that has passed lwIP's own source checks, before lwIP
  handles it as usual. The hook reads the packet and, if any question is
  for one of the firmware's records, answers it in a separate packet sent
  with get_mdns_pcb() (already exported by lwIP in mdns_priv.h). Nothing in
  lwIP's own answering, probing or announcing is changed.

mdns_out.c and mdns_domain.c are unmodified.
